ground_truth.title: Nörd Zero
ground_truth.main_content:
PURE VIBRAM SOLE

The EVO N24 model features a full Vibram® footbed, a high-performance technical sole known for its exceptional durability. This makes the sandal weather-resistant, suitable for use in seawater, and easy to clean with soap and water.

CORD PROTECTOR

Each year, we strive to improve our product by seeking the perfect balance between comfort and durability. This year, we've introduced a protective cover for the front elastic cord, extending its lifespan and offering a more comfortable and long-lasting sandal.

CLASSIC "COMPACT VERSION"

Compact design.

TECNICAL SPECIFICATIONS

Thickness: Vibram® 5mm
In our quest for quality, we opted for the most famous sole in the sector. Vibram® 5mm, light yet extremely resistant, that provides a better grip with ground and more durability*.

Laces: Nörd Lock System®
It took us a while to figure out which closure system to apply on this sandals. We wanted something minimalist with an aesthetic design while selecting the most resistant materials.
We also opted for the ease in the use and the option for washing and to disassemble some parts for replace if necessary.

*natural wear and tear will occur depending on the use and ageing of the product.

FAQ ABOUT ZERO, MINIMALIST SANDALS DESIGN

Does the cord hurt?
One of the first questions we are asked. Even if it might seem so, it doesn't because it is elastic.

MODEL #N24

Every year we work hard to improve the resistance and stay true to minimalism.
The #N24 model comes with 3 innovations: Bottom Rock Connector, Pure Vibram® Sole, FastReplace cord.

Protected elastic cord

Thanks to the lower Rock Connector, we have protected the elastic cord from premature wear.

Change the color

Change the color and return to the initial color.

Pros

- Superthin
- Walking barefoot
- Compact and super minimalist design
- Replaceable elastic cord
- Adjustable heel strap
- Lower Rock Connector protection
- Waterproof

Cons

- Limited elastic cord life (easy 3 minute replacement)

Barefoot level

Barefoot 100%
5mm Sole thickness

Weight

58gr
Calculated on 41 size

Activity

All day wear 100%
Excursions 80%
Running 60%

Best for

Everyday wear, urban exploration, barefoot trekking, travel

REVIEWS

They are amazing for wearing and walking for hours. You even forget you have them on. Nörd offers soft fit, though extremely comfortable. It was a bit harder to find the correct fitting point of the straps with other huaraches. Some hurt my feet for weeks, others left marks. With Nörd I felt an instant fit.

Alvaro
Expert Zapatillasminimalistas.net

Pros: It was the first time I was wearing 5mm soles, and it took me a couple of days to get used to them. Now, it actually feels strange to wear other cushioned shoes. Forget about super cushioned sandals; this is not the case, more like walking barefoot. I was already familiarised with this type of sandals and these were my first ones. At the moment they feel very good.
Cons: The shipping costs are a bit high but I bought replacement cords and the shipping was free.

Annes Y.
Buyer

Pros: Sandals with very nice aesthetics, super minimalist, actually the most miminalist I've found. I don't run in them, it's more for travelling, hiking and especially for summer in the city.
Cons: Nothing

Massimiliano C.
Buyer

Pros: The support was the best. They answer via whatsapp or email. I had to change the size and they provided an excellent customer service. 10 for support!
Cons: I recommend printing the sole and measuring really well, because the shipping cost for changes is on the buyer.

Carmelo A.
Buyer

Pros: Really nice aesthetics. Super comfy, doesn't rub against the instep thanks to the elastic cord.
Cons: nothing

Kay S.
Buyer

Pros: Despite the 5mm soles, the sandals are very comfortable, feels like walking barefoot but your feet are protected. If you change the elastic cord from time to time, they can practically last forever.
Cons: nothing

Thomas H.
Buyer

*Our website product photos are for advertising purposes, and potential risks have been assessed by specialists. The use of Nörd sandals is entirely at the user's own risk, whether in the city, mountains, or sea. Users should use the sandals wisely, considering their specific design and purpose.
